generalized_learning.generalized_failure_pattern: A delivery can become stale after a ready handoff when a later material commit changes product, tests, workflow or validation harness while the old certificate and exact-head controls are retained.
generalized_learning.plausible_wrong_implementation: Treat a post-handoff CI or harness fix as operational bookkeeping and preserve the prior certified material SHA instead of refreezing the delivery.
trigger_signals: commit after handoff touches non-audit path
current PR head differs from certified material head
result-only child parent does not equal certified material head
generalized_learning.prevention_rule: After any handoff, classify every later write by path and semantics; any material write invalidates exact-head evidence and requires post-write-refreeze before a new terminal child.
generalized_learning.detection_rule: At terminal and before independent audit, compare current head, certificate material head, direct parent and changed paths; reject stale identity or non-handoff child content.

transfer_cases.scenario: A CI/harness commit lands after handoff and changes executable validation behavior.
A source/test commit lands after handoff while an older certificate still reports ready.
A purported handoff child has a parent other than the certified material head or includes non-audit paths.

skill_changes.change: Delivery lifecycle now treats any non-result material write after freeze as an explicit post-write-refreeze trigger before terminal publication.
Terminal identity control compares material SHA, direct parent and changed-path allowlist before accepting a result-only child.
